title: Sun karakas / dignity
text: Sun：自然指示 灵魂、父亲、权威；本宫 Leo；擢升 Aries 10°；落陷 Libra 10°。Moolatrikona ['Leo', 0, 20]；度数区间依传本可异。
source: Prophet original concise compiled summary of standard Jyotisha tradition (Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra / BPHS); not a quotation or critical edition; Chinese names are working translations.

title: Moon karakas / dignity
text: Moon：自然指示 心智、母亲、滋养；本宫 Cancer；擢升 Taurus 3°；落陷 Scorpio 3°。Moolatrikona ['Taurus', 4, 30]；度数区间依传本可异。

title: Sun graha drishti
text: Sun 满相位：从自身所在宫计为第1宫，照第 [7] 宫。仅列满相位，不含分数相位。
